newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Supplies tightening.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Supplies tightening.

text.p: Spot millfeed values were mostly steady to higher, with many dealers reporting tight supplies for prompt shipment.
Feed mixers were most interested in prompt shipped goods for pre-Christmas production runs. Also, mixers want to build inventories ahead of Christmas week shutdowns by flour mills.
The Arctic air spreading through the central U.S. beginning Monday could have farmers and ranchers stockpiling feed ahead of the cold.
Buffalo sources said there was ample corn available there to prevent significant rises in millfeed prices.
Millfeeds traded higher in north Texas markets, but dealers there said Tuesday's traded volume was much less than during Monday's brisk activity.
